confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Denver price levels for July 2026, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than hotel and hostel anchors, which vary with season and events. FX: the only RBA observation I could retrieve is the cached table for 2026-03-20 (0.7088 USD per AUD), which is about seven months old. Attempts to find the latest RBA figure for 2026-10-15 failed and returned conflicting third-party numbers, so the server should refresh the FX observation before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized US western metros with strong leisure and business demand, such as Salt Lake City, Portland and Seattle. Bar and restaurant prices are set near the US urban mid-market level, and accommodation reflects summer demand.
